verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a first-party Headless Sync client that syncs vaults without the desktop app and is explicitly pitched for agents and automated workflows (obsidian-docs-10). Because notes are plain local Markdown files (obsidian-docs-20), an agent can read and write them without the GUI. Obsidian URI (obsidian-docs-8) and the plugin Vault API (obsidian-gh-1) also exist, but they are GUI-bound or developer building blocks rather than a headless read/write API. missing for 10: a documented local or vendor read/write API or official MCP server for notes, detail on how agent writes flow through headless sync, independent hands-on corroboration of agent read/write workflows.
